digest.component_or_area: reconciler comment echo preparation and manifest-driven reclaim
propositions: Six reconciler-created comment echoes on three tickets duplicate preexisting Jira copies, causing concentrated retained payload; exactly one survivor per body must be preserved and five rollout-created duplicates deleted in canary order

Immutable manifest must deterministically bind six ticket/body groups, six Jira deletion IDs, six proven survivors, and frozen source/Jira observation; every pagination, backup, ref, body, author identity, and copy-count ambiguity must refuse before any mutation

Jira cleanup tool must validate exact two-live-copy state, capture full backup and normalized plan before deletion, execute only via --execute flag with manifest digest, delete exactly six IDs in canary order, log append-only, verify survivor and non-target parity, and never perform blind retries

Local Git rewrite must remove only manifest-enumerated non-survivor COMMENT events and snapshots plus update epoch, preserve all six surviving events and unrelated material, and pass whole-store replay, topology, authorship, fsck, and blob/bridge parity checks

GitHub Actions reconcile-bridge.yml must be disabled before Jira deletion, with no queued/in-progress runs or live leases; execution sequence freezes both systems, deletes Jira IDs, rewrites local history, verifies both sides, replaces persistent clones, then re-enables only after non-resurrection validation

Preparation remains nonmutating: no Jira DELETE, workflow state change, authoritative ref push, writer pause, lease publication, or history rewrite shall occur until operator approval for separate execution ticket; all gates and dry-run observations must pass with immutable manifest and backup/restore validation
